name: Sovereign debt stress
summary: France–Bund spread 160bp, above the 150bp Alert line; general strike set for 5 Nov
state: France's 10-year spread over German Bunds was 159.9bp on 2 Nov, with the OAT yield at 4.91%, above the 150bp Alert line it first crossed on 20 Oct (Bloomberg). About 410,000 people marched on 31 Oct and unions have called a general strike for 5 Nov (Latin Times). No failed auction or emergency ECB buying has been reported.
for_you: French borrowing costs feed through to euro-area markets; travellers to France should expect disruption on 5 Nov.

sources.title: Bloomberg — French bond-risk gauge hits 150bp after protests
Latin Times — France protests: unions set 5 Nov general strike

why: When big governments struggle to borrow, it raises everyone's costs and can force sudden austerity or money-printing.
drivers: Deficits, auction demand, ratings actions, political shocks, long-end yields.

rubric.alert: Failed G7 auction, emergency central-bank purchases, France–Bund > 150bp, or Italy–Bund > 250bp.
rubric.watch: G7 30-year yields at multi-decade highs, a G7 downgrade, or France–Bund 80–150bp / Italy–Bund 150–250bp.
rubric.normal: Auctions orderly; France–Bund spread < 80bp; Italy–Bund < 150bp; no G7 downgrades this month.
